findings.claim: IEA Global EV Outlook 2026 稱2025年EV已替代全球約170萬桶/日石油消費（2020年為40萬），2025全球EV銷量約2,000萬輛、占新車四分之一；預期2030年替代量近三倍至約500萬桶/日。2026Q1全球EV銷量因中美政策放緩年減8%。
findings.source: ThisDay, Report: Electric Vehicles Cut Global Oil Demand by 1.7m bpd as Sales Top 20m (引IEA Global EV Outlook 2026)

findings.claim: IEA分析：中東戰爭致油價波動，至4月EV駕駛人運行成本節省提高20%-45%，為EV替代提供助力
findings.source: S&P Global / Hellenic Shipping News, Global oil shock offers boost for EV switching, fossil phaseout: IEA
findings.excerpt: countries in Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, have already unveiled plans to broaden EV tax incentives as a result of the crisis, while 30 countries broke records for monthly EV sales in March, the IEA said. After over a month of oil price volatility linked to the war in the Middle East, running cost savings for EV drivers had risen between 20% and 45% by April, according to IEA analysis.
